comment: Ratcheting line-coverage floor for the CTOC test-gate (src/scripts/test-gate.js). The gate fails when measured suite coverage drops below minPct. This is a RATCHET like .ctoc/typecheck-baseline.json: it may only ever be RAISED as coverage improves — NEVER lowered to make a failing run pass. New code is held to >= 80% at review (Iron Loop Step 14).
notes: Raised 40 -> 88 after fixing the gate's MEASUREMENT (v6.12.14). The old 40 recorded a broken metric: test-gate ran node --experimental-test-coverage over the 277-file test glob WITHOUT --test-coverage-include=src/**, so the aggregate denominator was inflated ~6x and read ~40% while real src line coverage was ~91%. The gate now scopes coverage to src/** and measures 91.18% line (node, scoped) / 88.5% (line-weighted hand-check). Floor set to 88 — just under the measured truth so coverage cannot silently regress, with ~3 points of headroom for cross-platform/run variance. Human-approved raise (Tijn, 2026-07-14). Never lower to make a run pass; fix the tests or the code. | Ratcheted 88->93 (v6.12.38): measured 94.05% after the coverage campaign (move-plan/hooks-installer/dependency-auditor 100%, version 95%, update 96.5%) + round-12 fixes. Never lower. | Ratcheted 93->95 (v6.12.39): measured 95.47% after the parallel non-obvious coverage batch (refinement-loop 100%, iron-loop 100%, menu 96.22%, quality-agent 91.97%, state 99.45%, actions 84.21%) AND the deletion of three false-green reimplementation test files (state.test.js/actions.test.js/iron-loop.test.js's simulated tests, which asserted on hand-written literals and never called the module). Never lower. | Ratcheted 95->96 (v6.12.40): measured 96.91% (after the third wave + the secrets-scanner external-findings fix) after the second non-obvious wave (vision-decomposer 100%, quality-gate 100%, operating-manual 100%, plan-validator 99.39%, areas/library 100% line). Never lower. | Held at 96 through v6.12.41 (secrets/iron-loop-enforcer/coverage-map/tui/push waves) and v6.12.42 (audit-chain/human-gate-check/ledger-backfill/release/overview waves + the overview 'r'-key dashboard-crash fix). Ratcheted 96->97 (v6.12.43): measured 97.47% after the fifth non-obvious wave (hash-utils 100%, review-tab 100%, multiedit-hook 100%, sync 100%, app-runner 95.34%). Never lower. | Held at 97 through v6.12.45-46 (six more non-obvious waves: menu/hooks/tabs/security/verify/governance modules, 35+ modules driven to ~100%). Ratcheted 97->98 (v6.12.47): measured 98.42% after the ninth non-obvious wave (regex-utils 100%, plan-index-bootstrap 100%, sast-runner 99.54%, migration-safety-checker 99.27%, stop-test-gate 99.11%). Never lower.
